S.TRANSL: 到現在還有這種草。
There is such grass until now.

FORM.notes: mutux=mu為標準發音，mutumu為簡略發音

S.FORM: ka yani mutumu talan.
S.PHON: ka jani mutumu talan
S.FORM: ka yani mutumu talan.
S.PHON: ka jani mutumu talan
S.TRANSL: 我會看到那個。
I would see that.

FORM.notes: t<um>apaq (搗，主焦型)；si-tapaq (搗，予焦型) q<um>umas (揉，主焦型)；qumas-un (揉，受焦型)；qumas-an (揉，處焦型)

S.FORM: tapaqun ku yani ru siqumas kiya la ga matasiq la.
S.PHON: tapaqun ku jani ru siqumas kija la ɣa matasiq la
S.FORM: tapaqun ku yani ru siqumas kiya la ga matasiq la.
S.PHON: tapaqun ku jani ru [s|ɕ]iquma[s|ɕ] kija la ɣa mata[s|ɕ]iq la
S.TRANSL: 把它搗爛然後和線團揉合在一起，就變成綠色。
(We) pounded it and massaged the threads with it, so it was green.

S.FORM: payux ga ga aqih gi ini' ini'mu qavaqani kumal ku asi.ki talan.
S.PHON: pajux ɣa ɣa aqiħ ɣi iniʔ iniʔmu qavaqani kumal ku asiki talan
S.FORM: payux ga ga aqih gi ini' ini'mu qavaqani kumal ku asi.ki talan.
S.PHON: pajux ɣa ɣa aqiħ ɣi iniʔ iniʔmu qa*aqani kumal ku a[s|ɕ]iki talan
S.TRANSL: 很多我都不會描述，要看到東西才行。
There is a lot that I can't describe. I need to have it here.

S.FORM: uwal a.
S.PHON: uwal a
S.FORM: uwal a.
S.PHON: uwal a
S.TRANSL: 是啊。
Yes.

FORM.notes: 此處不確定Pa'的語意。但整句語意為”變成線”。

S.FORM: pat u, pa' u wayay la ga.
S.PHON: pat u paʔ u wajaj la ɣa
S.FORM: pat u, pa' u wayay la ga.
S.PHON: pat u paʔ u wajaj la ɣa
S.TRANSL: 就變成線了。
It then becomes threads.

S.FORM: parumulun la.
S.PHON: parumulun la
S.FORM: parumulun la.
S.PHON: parumulun la
S.TRANSL: 就變成線團。
(We) make it into balls of threads.

S.FORM: parumulun la ru ju,
S.PHON: parumulun la ru ju
S.FORM: parumulun la ru ju,
S.PHON: parumulun la ru ju
S.TRANSL: 把它繞成線團。
(We) coil them into balls.

S.FORM: qalasayun la.
S.PHON: qalasajun la
S.FORM: qalasayun la.
S.PHON: qala[s|ɕ]ajun la
S.TRANSL: 我們把線繞(在織布機上)。
(We) coil the threads (on the weaving box).

S.FORM: qalasayun la ru tinunun la.
S.PHON: qalasajun la ru tinunun la
S.FORM: qalasayun la ru tinunun la.
S.PHON: qala[s|ɕ]ajun la ru tinunun la
S.TRANSL: 我們繞線(在織布機上)，然後編織。
(We) coil the threads and weave.

S.FORM: ru. ru kiya a. la tiku lin, tiku linamu' ga,
S.PHON: ru ru kija a la tiku lin tiku linamuʔ ɣa
S.FORM: ru. ru kiya a. la tiku lin, tiku linamu' ga,
S.PHON: ru ru kija a la tiku lin tiku linamuʔ ɣa
S.TRANSL: 然後有配好的顏色。
And there is chosen stuff

S.FORM: velayq talan ku linamu' ga vaq su waw ma.
S.PHON: velajq talan ku linamuʔ ɣa vaq su waw ma
S.FORM: velayq talan ku linamu' ga vaq su waw ma.
S.PHON: *elajq talan ku linamuʔ ɣa *aq [s|ɕ]u waw ma
S.TRANSL: 顏色配得好看，(別人)就說(這個人)很會做(編織的)事。
If the chosen colors look good, others will say that you are good at weaving.

FORM.notes: Tamalx 為副詞性動詞詞根，後接主焦型動詞。T<in>amalx-an 受焦型。 asi tamalx-i i t<um>ahuk ku raramat ‘Just cook the vegetable as you wish.'

S.FORM: maha ku nanavakis ini' qavaq la ga yani ku tana asinaha' tamalxi la ka ukas ku linamu' ga.
S.PHON: maħa ku nanavakis iniʔ qavaq la ɣa jani ku tana asinaħaʔ tamalxi la ka ukas ku linamuʔ ɣa
S.FORM: maha ku nanavakis ini' qavaq la ga yani ku tana asinaha' tamalxi la ka ukas ku linamu' ga.
S.PHON: maħa ku nana*aki[s|ɕ] iniʔ qa*aq la ɣa jani ku tana a[s|ɕ]inaħaʔ tamalxi la ka uka[s|ɕ] ku linamuʔ ɣa
S.TRANSL: 老人家這麼說，如果不會(配色)，就是他們只好隨便(配)，沒有挑好色。
The elderly said that if they were not able to choose nice color (combination), then they could only pick some at random.

S.FORM: yow ukas a ukas a.
S.PHON: jow ukas a ukas a
S.FORM: yow ukas a ukas a.
S.PHON: jow uka[s|ɕ] a uka[s|ɕ] a
S.TRANSL: 喲，沒有，沒有。
Well, no, no.

FORM.notes: imi為「意義」，日文借字。

S.FORM: a imi' nku asi nku yani hiya'.
S.PHON: a imiʔ nku asi nku jani ħijaʔ
S.FORM: a imi' nku asi nku yani hiya'.
S.PHON: a imiʔ nku a[s|ɕ]i nku jani ħijaʔ
S.TRANSL: 它意思就像那個。
Its meaning is like that.

FORM.notes: itaal專指泰雅族人。 泰雅織布習俗之一為男人不碰織布器具。

S.FORM: na naqu ga i gaga' na itaal ga ukas.
S.PHON: na naqu ɣa i ɣaɣaʔ na itaal ɣa ukas
S.FORM: na naqu ga i gaga' na itaal ga ukas.
S.PHON: na naqu ɣa i ɣaɣaʔ na itaal ɣa uka[s|ɕ]
S.TRANSL: 本族人沒有這個習俗。
Our tribemen do not have such a convention.

FORM.notes: 依錄音內容，泰雅編織圖樣以個人創意為主，沒有固定的模式。

S.FORM: ukas ku maha asi.ki kiya ku lngawniya' ga.
S.PHON: ukas ku maħa asiki kija ku lŋawnijaʔ ɣa
S.FORM: ukas ku maha asi.ki kiya ku lngawniya' ga.
S.PHON: uka[s|ɕ] ku maħa a[s|ɕ]iki kija ku lŋawnijaʔ ɣa
S.TRANSL: 沒有人說它(紋路的編織)必須有方向。
No one says that there must be certain ways of pattern weaving.

S.FORM: asi.ki kiya ku i mahananu' ku linmu mayungniya' ga.
S.PHON: asiki kija ku i maħananuʔ ku linmu majuŋnijaʔ ɣa
S.FORM: asi.ki kiya ku i mahananu' ku linmu mayungniya' ga.
S.PHON: a[s|ɕ]iki kija ku i maħananuʔ ku linmu majuŋnijaʔ ɣa
S.TRANSL: 有時候我配好的顏色要有某些紋路。
Sometimes there must be some pattern for my chosen colors.

S.FORM: asi.ki kiya ku lngawniya' ma ukas ku mwani.
S.PHON: asiki kija ku lŋawnijaʔ ma ukas ku mwani
S.FORM: asi.ki kiya ku lngawniya' ma ukas ku mwani.
S.PHON: a[s|ɕ]iki kija ku lŋawnijaʔ ma uka[s|ɕ] ku mwani
S.TRANSL: 有人說一定照著某個模樣，可是沒有這樣子。
Some say that (we) have to follow a pattern in weaving, but it is not so.

S.PHON: asiki
S.FORM: asi.ki,
